narratives.body: LiveScore discusses a reported move for Tresoldi involving AC Milan and Arsenal with a 60 million figure, potentially as early as January.
narratives.headline: Tresoldi: transfer reports

narratives.body: 조선일보 reports that AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after Maignan received a red card. LiveScore reports that Bournemouth defeated AC Milan 3-0 with Maignan sent off on the south coast. TNT Sports notes that Milan's performance was described as 'Absolutely farcical' and they forgot to make a substitution.
narratives.headline: AC Milan: Europa League collapse

narratives.body: LiveScore quotes Pavlovic stating Milan are on the right track despite too many mistakes.
narratives.headline: Pavlovic: team assessment
